g.text: Objective: name the company's story type with the first rule that matches, then let the override file replace it.
back to the analyze board
the company is not distressed
the company is not cyclical
the company is not high-growth

text.tspan: the classifier has named a story type
first match wins, in this order
distressed
cyclical
high-growth
mature-decline
mature-stable

g.text: the command crashes (exit code 1)
the story type is settled
Gap: Altman Z is read by the classifier but computed nowhere, and analyze never passes it; only interest coverage can make a company distressed.
the signals are derived
the ticker cannot be valued (exit code 1)
the sector row is read
config/assumptions/TICKER.yaml, manual overrides

text.tspan: Comes out:
the story type the assumptions will follow, and the classifier's own type for the report
the classifier says distressed [interest coverage at most 1.0]
or Altman Z < 1.81, which analyze never supplies

g.text: not distressed [interest coverage above 1.0 or unknown]

text.tspan: the classifier says cyclical [cyclical sector and earnings variation at least 0.50]
coefficient of variation = standard deviation ÷ |mean| of net income
(population standard deviation; fewer than two years or mean 0: not cyclical)

g.text: not cyclical [otherwise]

text.tspan: the classifier says high-growth [revenue growth at least 15% a year and age at most 25 years or unknown]
revenue compound annual growth rate (CAGR)
CAGR = (last ÷ first)^(1 ÷ (years − 1)) − 1
unknown age counts as young
fewer than two years, or first or last ≤ 0: mature-stable

g.text: not high-growth [otherwise]

text.tspan: the classifier says mature-decline [revenue growth at most −1% a year]
CAGR ≤ −1%

g.text: the classifier says mature-stable [every other company]
the command crashes, exit code 1 [the override file is not valid YAML, or a value is empty or a list where a number is expected]
the ticker cannot be valued, exit code 1 [the override file is not a mapping or has an unknown key]
the classifier's story type stands [no story type in the override file]
the override file's story type replaces it [story type set in the file; an unknown label drives no branch]
story_type key, read with every other override
the sector row is found [its region's, else another region's]
no sector row [industry absent from every region]
the story type goes on to the assumptions [always]
